title: Little Whale Swim School

services.name: Swim Class Tuition
services.desc: Tuition is applied on a monthly auto-debit system. Tuition includes up to 4 weekly lessons, plus one quarterly bonus lesson per enrollment (can be used as a make-up or drop-in lesson)* and unlimited Family

services.name: Class Levels
services.desc: LWSS is the premier swim school of the greater Sacramento area. Our custom built, indoor swim facilities offer a learn to swim experience like no other. Owner Anya Hall brings over 40 years of experience in the swim industry. Specially trained teachers guide swimmers through a series of songs and games designed to develop breath control, balance and buoyancy (the 3 B’s). Skills Learned All students will learn to submerge and float on their backs with support, as well as grasp the wall. They learn safety skills including underwater submersions, back floats, and grasping the wall are practiced. Goggles are encouraged and fins are introduced around 12 months. Specially trained teachers guide
